rules.claim: Result sound 2009/2010 is emitted by Proj_xqzdOverUI.Awake f18084 / Proj_xqzdFailUI.Awake f18095. These override GFRunning.UIObject.Awake slot 8. UIObject.initGameObject f4713 calls slot8 explicitly at 0018df09..0018df29 after component/skin/initialize stages. Local preloaded panels must emit at each corresponding result-open transition, not preload.

BaseUI.CloseSelf f6251 delegates UIModule.CloseForName f6911. The active-window dictionary at UIModule+48 removes the named window before _closeUI f13074. UIModule.Open f7381 returns a still-registered nonnull window; otherwise Activator.CreateInstance(table1318 -> f1522) constructs a new BaseUI, registers it, calls _openUI, and LoadGameObject calls initGameObject. Thus after a normal close/retry the next result gets a new framework Awake and sound. BaseUI.CloseUINow f31586 explicitly destroys the UI GameObject via Object.Destroy(table2825 ->f1165).

unknowns.detail: The full _closeUI asynchronous animation cleanup state machine is not decoded here; registry removal and subsequent framework Awake are already sufficient to determine result sound replay.
